content.value: Assume that every student of 2nd year mechanical takes five class tests on which score ranges from O - 25, and his final grade will be the average of the three highest test scores plus the term final marks which ranges from O - 75. Write a program which finds the final grades (marks) of 120 students.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
